newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Ninghu Expressway to issue one bln shares abroad.
newsitem.headline: Ninghu Expressway to issue one bln shares abroad.

text.p: Jiangsu Ninghu Expressway Co Ltd plans to apply to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for an offer of one billion foreign currency shares for listing abroad in 1997, a company spokesman said on Tuesday.
HSBC Investment Asia Ltd would be appointed to underwrite the firm's shares, he told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.

Ninghu, which is one of 38 domestic firms newly selected by the Securities Commission of the State Council as candidates for overseas listings, operates a 274-kilometre highway linking Nanjing and Shanghai, the official said.
The firm, headquartered in Nanjing, capital of eastern Jiangsu province, has not decided where it would apply to list the shares, he said.
If the offer goes through, the company would use the share proceeds to construct highways within Jiangsu and buy the operating rights of some domestic highways, the official said.
Ninghu's profits over the past few years will not be released until an ongoing audit is finalised, the official said.
The 4.7-billion-yuan Nanjing-Shanghai expressway opened for traffic in October 1996, he said, adding the highway has so far produced revenue of about 100 million yuan.
Ninghu currently has total share capital of 1.9 billion shares, composed of 800 million state shares and 1.1 billion legal person, or institutional, shares.
